whoItsFor: Creators and developers who use a coding agent to build art-style motion pieces and explainer-video segments entirely in code. They should be comfortable running Python tooling via uv and ffmpeg.
useCases: Break down a reference animation into cuts, beat grid, and motion heatmaps, then recreate it in code
Render art-style scenes such as Van Gogh, Bauhaus, or 8-bit as animated, code-drawn frames
Generate frame-accurate explainer-video clips from a JSON spec in landscape, portrait, or transparent formats
